data.action: 站在全息投影前核对数据
data.description: 【佩丽卡 · 终末地实验室】终末地工业先遣基地核心实验室内，身为监管人的佩丽卡正伫立在巨大的全息三维星图投影前，神情严谨专注地校对着开拓区源石能源的输送网络数据。她扶了扶耳侧的通讯发饰转过身——「管理员，塔罗斯II星域的基础设施建设进度已达标，下一阶段的拓荒方案需要您的最终授权。」
data.lighting: cool lab light with hologram glow
data.promptProse: Perlica checks the energy-distribution network before a large holographic star map in the Endfield base laboratory. Wearing her white cropped techwear jacket over a high-neck tunic, she adjusts the communication accessory beside her ear and turns toward the Administrator. The medium view includes projection layers before storage equipment behind. Cool laboratory light defines her wide sleeves, while hologram glow reflects on her glove and concentrated face.
data.title: 佩丽卡 · 终末地实验室
